settings.heading: Before you buy
settings.text: Answers to the questions we hear most. Still unsure? Our team is happy to help.

settings.question: How do I choose the right size?
settings.answer: Measure your room and check the dimensions shown on the product page. Leave space around the bed to walk and to open drawers or an ottoman lift.

settings.question: Can I choose a different fabric or storage option?
settings.answer: The fabrics, colours and storage choices for each bed are listed on its product page. Contact the store if you would like help comparing them.

settings.question: Is the mattress included with a bed?
settings.answer: Each product page says what is included. Beds and mattresses are usually sold separately, so you can pair the comfort you prefer.

settings.question: Where can I find delivery and returns information?
settings.answer: See the delivery and returns pages linked at the foot of every page, or contact the team before ordering.
